The revision also cut the hinge 'supposing society to be ignored, the philosopher was no further forward'. 'Nihilism had no bottom' now follows the social-punishment sentence as a non sequitur.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: Readers may infer anarchism equals denial of unity, and the bomb line remains vivid on its own.
